# OpeningHoursEditor

Pointr Cloud's Opening Hours property editor (CLOUD-UI-004): the seven days, each Hours, Closed or Always open, and for Hours its opening and closing time, typed or chosen. A Dashboard module: it ships from `@kozmos-ds/react/dashboard`, with `@kozmos-ds/react/dashboard.css` loaded after the package's `style.css`, and only on the web.

- **Import:** `import { OpeningHoursEditor } from "@kozmos-ds/react/dashboard";`
- **Stylesheet:** `import "@kozmos-ds/react/dashboard.css";`, after the package's `style.css`: a Dashboard module's rules are in this sheet alone.
- **Group:** Dashboard
- **Platforms:** React; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/dashboard-openinghourseditor--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";
import { OpeningHoursEditor, PropertyField } from "@kozmos-ds/react/dashboard";

export function OpeningHoursEditorExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <PropertyField name="Opening Hours" onRemove={() => {}}>
        <OpeningHoursEditor locale="en-GB" />
      </PropertyField>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## OpeningHoursEditor

The Opening Hours property's editor (CLOUD-UI-004): the seven days, each
Hours, Closed or Always open, and for Hours its opening and closing time.
Every control is reached by Tab (Cloud's had no tab stop). Overnight hours
are allowed (decision 179): a closing time before the opening time is the
next day's, and "+1 day" says so beside it, and to a screen reader with
the field.

Built from SegmentedControl, for the three states a day can be in, one at
a time (two switches, Cloud's, can both be on), and TimePicker, typed or
chosen from its list. A Dashboard module (decision 183).

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `OpeningHoursEditorProps`, which extends `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "defaultValue" | "onChange">`.

- `value`: `OpeningHours`, optional.

  The week, for a product that holds it.

- `defaultValue`: `OpeningHours`, optional, default `DEFAULT_OPENING_HOURS`.

  The week an editor that holds its own starts with. Cloud's default.

- `onValueChange`: `(value: OpeningHours, day: Weekday) => void`, optional.

  Called with the whole week after each edit, and the day edited.

- `locale`: `string`, optional.

  Names the days, through Intl; by default the browser's language.

- `weekStart`: `Weekday`, optional, default `"monday"`.

  The day listed first. Default Monday, the value's own order.

- `stepMinutes`: `number`, optional, default `5`.

  The minutes between the times the list of times offers, and the step a
  time field's Up and Down Arrow keys take, whichever part of the time is
  focused, on that grid, carrying into the hour and round midnight: 5 from
  08:00 back is 07:55, from 23:55 on is 00:00. The browser's own arrows
  step one part by one and never carry, so the editor takes them over.
  Default 5, Cloud's.

- `mixedDays`: `readonly Weekday[]`, optional, default `[]`.

  Days whose hours differ across a multi-selection (GAP-153): no choice
  is drawn, and `mixedLabel` says so, until the visitor chooses one.

- `mixedLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Multiple values"`.

  Default "Multiple values".

- `onResetMixed`: `Partial<Record<Weekday, () => void>>`, optional.

  Per day, going back to the multi-selection's several hours: drawn
  under the day while it is not mixed. Give it for a day that was.

- `resetMixedLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Reset to multiple values"`.

  Default "Reset to multiple values".

- `hoursLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Hours"`.

  The choices' words. Defaults "Hours", "Closed", "Always open".

- `closedLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Closed"`.
- `alwaysOpenLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Always open"`.
- `nextDayLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"+1 day"`.

  Drawn beside a close time before the open time. Default "+1 day".

- `timeLabel`: `(day: string, edge: "open" | "close") => string`, optional, default `` (day, edge) => `${day} ${edge === "open" ? "opening" : "closing"} time` ``.

  Names a time field. Default `<day> opening time`, `<day> closing time`.

- `chooseTimeLabel`: `(field: string) => string`, optional, default `` (field) => `Choose ${field}` ``.

  Names a time field's list button. Default `Choose <time field>`.

- `disabled`: `boolean`, optional.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## Types these props take

### OpeningHours

From `@kozmos-ds/react/dashboard`.

```ts
/** A week's hours, one entry per day. */
type OpeningHours = Record<Weekday, OpeningHoursDay>;
```

### Weekday

From `@kozmos-ds/react/dashboard`.

```ts
type Weekday = (typeof WEEKDAYS)[number];
```

### OpeningHoursDay

From `@kozmos-ds/react/dashboard`.

```ts
/**
 * One day's hours: closed all day, open all day, or open from `open` to
 * `close`, each `HH:MM` on the 24-hour clock. A `close` before `open` is
 * the next day's (decision 179): 18:00 to 02:00 closes at 2 in the night.
 */
type OpeningHoursDay =
  | {
      closed: true;
    }
  | {
      alwaysOpen: true;
    }
  | {
      open: string;
      close: string;
    };
```

## Also exported

- `WEEKDAYS`: `readonly ["monday", "tuesday", "wednesday", "thursday", "friday", "saturday", "sunday"]`. The days of the week, Monday first, as the value names them.
- `DEFAULT_OPENING_HOURS`: `OpeningHours`. A new Opening Hours property's week, Pointr Cloud's: Monday to Friday 08:00 to 22:00, Saturday and Sunday closed.
